## Problem
Users of notes-api cannot see when a shared note was last edited, so they edit stale copies and lose changes.

## Proposed Outcome
Every shared note shows when it was last edited.

## Affected Users And Systems
- Users: note authors and readers
- Services: `notes-api`, `sync-worker`

## Constraints
- Edit times come from the edit history and are never invented.

## Open Questions
- None.

## Source
- Origin: idea from the product team
- Author: product team

## Intent
`.pipes/project/01-intents/intent-901-last-edit-time.md`: shared notes show when they were last edited.

## Requirements
- **R1** The note response of `notes-api` includes the time of the last edit when the edit history has one.
- **R2** The edit time is shown in UTC.

## Design
### notes-api
- Change: add `lastEditedAt` to the saved note.

## Risk Class
routine: one consumer.
